description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Vannarpannai, Nallur D/S Division, Jaffna District (25/0030)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations, property ownership determinations, and land parcel details under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land ownership for specific parcels, including owner names, property extents, encumbrances, and cadastral information, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
